SQLite native library (included in SQLitePCLRaw.lib.e_sqlite3)

SQLite's core library and the sqlite3.c/sqlite3.h amalgamation are in the
public domain. SQLitePCLRaw's packaging and managed bindings are separately
covered by sqlitepcl-license.txt and sqlitepcl-notice.txt.

Official copyright statement:
https://www.sqlite.org/copyright.html
